name: athenaOne Ambient Notes
description: athenaOne Ambient Notes is athenahealth's ambient AI documentation solution with two distinct paths: 1) athenaAmbient—a FREE native AI scribe announced February 2026 and generally available August 2026, included at no extra cost for 160,000+ athenaOne users; 2) Ambient Notes Marketplace—a choose-your-player model letting clinicians pick from embedded AI models including Suki AI, iScribe AI, Abridge, and Microsoft Dragon Copilot (first half 2026). athenaAmbient goes beyond scribing with diagnosis and order suggestions. This is a major market shift: free, built-in ambient AI without third-party vendors—compared to typical $200-600/provider/month alternatives. Best for athenaOne users wanting native, no-additional-cost ambient documentation.

faqs.q: How much does athenaOne Ambient Notes cost in 2026?
faqs.a: athenaOne Ambient Notes is FREE—included at no extra cost for all athenaOne users. This includes both athenaAmbient (native AI scribe) and the Ambient Notes Marketplace (Suki, Abridge, iScribe, Dragon Copilot). No incremental charge, embedded in core athenaOne fee.

faqs.q: What is athenaAmbient vs Ambient Notes?
faqs.a: athenaAmbient is athenahealth's native first-party AI scribe (GA August 2026) with diagnosis and order suggestions. Ambient Notes Marketplace is a choose-your-player model letting you pick from embedded third-party AI models like Suki, Abridge, and iScribe. Both are free for athenaOne users.
athenaAmbient entered user testing February 2026 with general availability in August 2026. Ambient Notes Marketplace is live now with multiple AI model options.

faqs.q: Is athenaOne Ambient Notes good for mental health practices?
faqs.a: athenaOne Ambient Notes works for general clinical documentation. Mental health therapists should use purpose-built tools like Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo). Psychiatrists may want DeepCura ($129/mo) or mdhub for MSE and medication management features.

faqs.q: athenaOne Ambient Notes vs third-party AI scribes: which is better?
faqs.a: For athenaOne users, Ambient Notes is hard to beat—it's free vs. $200-600/mo for alternatives like Nuance DAX. If you already use athenaOne, start with the native solution. Only consider third-party if you need specific features not available in athenaAmbient.
